## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and result of this change.

## Verification

List the tests and build actually run, plus any missing checks and their reason. For visual changes, include the affected screen with fictional data and the viewport reviewed.

## Scope and risks

Mention state migrations, compatibility changes, permissions, new dependencies or relevant limitations. Distinguish fixture, browser, native and real-provider evidence.

- [ ] The change contains no private records, credentials or personal runtime logs.
- [ ] Behavior and documentation agree; third-party assets retain provenance and licenses.
- [ ] Required checks passed, or the exact blocking reason is described above.
